validation: 20 repeated deterministic 5-fold observed-cell cross-validations; ridge selected from the fixed grid 0.001 to 10; each latent rank compared with the best tuned additive family+trait model.
interpretation: No low-rank allocation regime improves prediction in BIEN. AusTraits shows a modest rank-1 predictive gain on both tree treatments. The latent structure is therefore compilation-specific at present and cannot be promoted to the cross-dataset central claim.
hard_nonclaims: Do not call the AusTraits rank-1 factor a universal evolutionary regime.
Do not treat failure in BIEN as proof that its allocation is completely unstructured.
AusTraits has a denser set of correlated organ-dimension traits than BIEN, which may enable a detectable low-rank axis.
